posts.headline: Shake N Bakers bounce right back to the top of the points race at 879.84, and triciagloston's lone blemish is looking more like a speed bump than a crack in the dam.
posts.detail: At 5-1 with a league-best scoring total, this is still the standard every other team in Busters Anonymous is chasing — the revenge tour just added another verse.

posts.headline: One Nut Barner's fraud case goes to trial with a career 20-8 record and a league-best 1.5 average finish laughably mismatched against a 1-5 reality.
posts.detail: Thirty-three editions later and the 714 win percentage on his resume is basically a eulogy — Cal Berkeley grad or not, the GPA jokes write themselves right alongside the standings.

posts.headline: Sasinci can't buy a win at 2-4, and Big Head's title defense has curdled harder than the Milk Man nickname ever predicted.
posts.detail: A reigning-pedigree contender with a 13-15 career record and 5.5 average finish is now staring up at the standings, and the quit-the-league clock has to be ticking.

posts.headline: Thicks is still 4-2 up top, but 721.1 points-for remains the flimsiest resume of any first-place team in the league.
posts.detail: Thirty-three editions of pointing at that 14-14 career record and 5.5 average finish, and the ring is starting to feel like a rental, not a possession.

posts.headline: Chauncey's talentedtenthh stays buried at 1-5, and a 613.1 scoring total confirms the name isn't irony anymore — it's a diagnosis.
posts.detail: A career 4-10 record and dead-last 12 average finish say this isn't a rough patch, it's the whole identity of the franchise.
